messages: leo: Heads-up: after the migration to the new docusaurus config a bunch of internal anchors are failing (anchors with dots and underscores). Linkcheck flagged ~14 anchor 404s. leo: CI log snippet: ``` LinkCheckError: /guides/deploy#step.2-config -> 404 Not Found Referenced from: docs/guides/deploy.md:88 LinkCheckError: /reference/sdk#client_init_v1 -> 404 Not Found Referenced from: docs/reference/sdk.md:120 ``` docs-bot: CI: linkcheck step failed for PR #2421 (checks/linkcheck) :warning: anya: I saw this yesterday. The anchor slugifier changed when we flipped to the new markdown plugin (kebab-case now vs old behavior that preserved underscores/dots). We need to either normalize legacy anchors or tweak the slugify function to be backward-compatible. tessa: Quick option: add explicit HTML anchors in the markdown (``) for problematic headings so the new slugifier doesn't need to match legacy ones. Not ideal but minimal. ram: Longer term I'd prefer a slugifier shim in the build that maps old->new anchor variants. I can generate a small mapping script that scans headings and emits redirects.json entries of the form {"from": "/reference/sdk#client_init_v1","to":"/reference/sdk#client-init-v1"}. That will preserve inbound links. anya: +1 to redirects. Also we should update the docs style guide: don't rely on automatic anchor generation for stable permalinks; recommend explicit HTML anchors for public-facing headings. leo: For immediate unblock, tessa please add the HTML anchors to the three worst offenders in the SDK and guides pages and open a patch. ram, can you start the redirect generator and run it on docs/* to produce a draft redirects.json? tessa: Will do. I'll push a small PR with the three HTML anchor fixes and tag @ram for follow-up. ram: I'll run the generator and post the draft mapping here in the thread. If folks are happy I'll wire it into docusaurus config under `plugins: redirects`. leo: Also add a note to the migration guide about slug changes and the rule we used (lowercase, hyphens for spaces, strip punctuation). We should surface this so editors know why anchors changed. anya: I'll draft the migration blurb and add examples of problematic headings to avoid. leo: Thanks team. Once PRs merge we'll re-run linkcheck. If anything else pops up we can add temporary whitelist entries in CI to avoid blocking unrelated doc fixes. :thumbsup:
